title: AI Gives Cyberattackers an Edge—for Now, Says Singapore Cyber Official
why_it_matters_hint: From the headline only: a Singapore cyber official says AI currently favours attackers, and 'for now' suggests the balance may change.
notes: No article text obtained. The WSJ page returned HTTP 401 (bot challenge) both in the main session's fetch and on a retry, and Google News searches on 6 Oct 2026 (several phrasings, 3 and 7 day windows) found no other outlet carrying this story. Related but different Singapore items exist (CNA and Straits Times, 1 to 2 Oct 2026, on Josephine Teo and a Thales speech) and were not used because they are not this story. The official's name, role, the event where it was said and the evidence are unknown.
